The **2014–15 Danish 1st Division** was the **20th season** of the **Danish 1st Division**, the second-tier football league in Denmark, since its establishment in 1991. The season ran from **July 2014 to May 2015** and featured **12 teams** competing for promotion to the **Danish Superliga** and avoiding relegation to the **Danish 2nd Division**.

---

### **Key Details**
- **League Format**:
  - **Double round-robin** (22 matches per team).
  - **Top two teams** promoted to the **2015–16 Danish Superliga**.
  - **3rd-place team** entered a **promotion/relegation playoff** against the **10th-place Superliga team**.
  - **Bottom two teams** relegated to the **2015–16 Danish 2nd Division**.
  - **10th-place team** entered a **relegation playoff** against the **3rd-place 2nd Division team**.

- **Defending Champions**:
  - **Silkeborg IF** (promoted to Superliga in 2013–14).
  - **Hobro IK** (also promoted).

- **Promoted from 2nd Division (2013–14)**:
  - **Skive IK** (champions).
  - **Nykøbing FC** (runners-up).

---

### **Final Standings (2014–15)**
| Pos | Team               | Pld | W | D | L | GF | GA | GD | Pts | Promotion/Relegation |
|-----|--------------------|-----|---|---|---|----|----|----|-----|----------------------|
| **1** | **Viborg FF**      | 33  | 20 | 8 | 5 | 66 | 30 | +36 | **68** | **Promoted to Superliga** |
| **2** | **AGF**            | 33  | 19 | 9 | 5 | 60 | 28 | +32 | **66** | **Promoted to Superliga** |
| **3** | **Hobro IK**       | 33  | 16 | 10 | 7 | 55 | 35 | +20 | **58** | **Promotion Playoff** (won vs. **Vestsjælland**) |
| **4** | **Silkeborg IF**   | 33  | 15 | 9 | 9 | 58 | 40 | +18 | **54** |  |
| **5** | **FC Fredericia**  | 33  | 14 | 9 | 10 | 50 | 41 | +9 | **51** |  |
| **6** | **Næstved BK**     | 33  | 13 | 8 | 12 | 45 | 45 | 0 | **47** |  |
| **7** | **Skive IK**       | 33  | 11 | 10 | 12 | 40 | 44 | -4 | **43** |  |
| **8** | **FC Roskilde**    | 33  | 11 | 8 | 14 | 40 | 49 | -9 | **41** |  |
| **9** | **AB Copenhagen**  | 33  | 10 | 10 | 13 | 38 | 44 | -6 | **40** |  |
| **10** | **Nykøbing FC**    | 33  | 10 | 9 | 14 | 37 | 45 | -8 | **39** | **Relegation Playoff** (lost vs. **Thisted FC**) |
| **11** | **FC Hjørring**    | 33  | 8 | 8 | 17 | 36 | 54 | -18 | **32** | **Relegated to 2nd Division** |
| **12** | **B.93**          | 33  | 2 | 8 | 23 | 25 | 71 | -46 | **14** | **Relegated to 2nd Division** |

*(Note: The table includes results from the **regular season (33 matches)** due to the **split into promotion/relegation groups** after 22 rounds.)*

---

### **Season Structure & Key Events**
1. **Regular Season (22 Rounds)**:
   - Teams played each other twice (home & away).
   - After 22 matches, the league **split into two groups**:
     - **Top 6 (Promotion Group)**: Played 10 more matches (5 home, 5 away) for promotion spots.
     - **Bottom 6 (Relegation Group)**: Played 10 more matches to avoid relegation.

2. **Promotion Playoff**:
   - **Hobro IK (3rd place)** faced **FC Vestsjælland (10th in Superliga)** in a two-legged playoff.
   - **Hobro won 3–2 on aggregate** and were promoted to the **Superliga**, while Vestsjælland were relegated.

3. **Relegation Playoff**:
   - **Nykøbing FC (10th place)** faced **Thisted FC (3rd in 2nd Division)**.
   - **Thisted won 3–1 on aggregate**, relegating Nykøbing to the **2nd Division**.

---

### **Top Scorers (2014–15)**
| Rank | Player            | Club               | Goals |
|------|-------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **1** | **Morten Rasmussen** | Viborg FF          | **20** |
| **2** | **Jeppe Kjær**     | AGF                | **17** |
| **3** | **Martin Spelmann** | Hobro IK           | **15** |
| **4** | **Anders K. Jacobsen** | Silkeborg IF   | **14** |
| **5** | **Lasse Nielsen**   | FC Fredericia      | **13** |

---

### **Notable Teams & Stories**
1. **Viborg FF**:
   - **Champions** of the 1st Division, returning to the **Superliga** after one season.
   - Led by manager **Johnny Mølby**, they dominated with a strong attack (66 goals).
   - Key players: **Morten Rasmussen (20 goals)**, **Lasse Nielsen**, and **Jeppe Grønning**.

2. **AGF (Aarhus Gymnastikforening)**:
   - **Runners-up**, securing an immediate return to the **Superliga** after relegation in 2013–14.
   - Managed by **Glen Riddersholm**, they had a solid defense (28 goals conceded).
   - Star player: **Jeppe Kjær (17 goals)**.

3. **Hobro IK**:
   - **Promoted via playoff** after finishing 3rd.
   - Continued their rise after promotion from the **2nd Division in 2013**.
   - **Martin Spelmann (15 goals)** was crucial.

4. **Silkeborg IF**:
   - **4th place**, missing out on promotion after relegation from the Superliga in 2013–14.
   - Struggled with inconsistency but had talent like **Anders K. Jacobsen (14 goals)**.

5. **B.93 & FC Hjørring**:
   - **Relegated** after poor seasons.
   - **B.93** won only **2 matches** all season, finishing last.
   - **FC Hjørring** (traditionally a women’s football powerhouse) struggled in men’s football.

---

### **Cup Performance (2014–15 Danish Cup)**
- **Viborg FF** reached the **quarterfinals** (lost to **Randers FC**).
- **AGF** reached the **semifinals** (lost to **FC Copenhagen**).
- **Hobro IK** were eliminated in the **3rd round** by **Silkeborg IF**.

*(The **2014–15 Danish Cup** was won by **FC Copenhagen**, who beat **Vestsjælland 3–2** in the final.)*

---

### **Managerial Changes**
| Club          | Outgoing Manager | Incoming Manager | Date       |
|---------------|-------------------|-------------------|------------|
| **FC Roskilde** | Peter Sørensen    | Michael Hansen    | Nov 2014   |
| **Næstved BK**  | Claus Nørgaard    | Henrik Lehm       | Dec 2014   |
| **Skive IK**    | Jakob Michelsen   | Lars Søndergaard  | Mar 2015   |

---

### **Attendance & Fan Culture**
- **Average attendance**: ~1,500–2,000 per match (higher for AGF, Viborg, and Silkeborg).
- **AGF** had the highest average (~4,000–5,000), benefiting from their large fanbase.
- **Hobro IK** saw increased support due to their recent promotions.

---

### **Aftermath & Legacy**
- **Viborg FF** and **AGF** both **stayed in the Superliga** for several seasons post-promotion.
- **Hobro IK** had a **strong 2015–16 Superliga season**, finishing **5th** (their best-ever top-flight performance).
- **Silkeborg IF** returned to the **Superliga in 2016–17** after another 1st Division title.
- **B.93** and **FC Hjørring** struggled in the **2nd Division** afterward, with B.93 later merging with **FA 2000** to form **B.93/FA 2000**.

---

### **Fun Facts**
- **Viborg FF’s Morten Rasmussen** (20 goals) was the **only player to score 20+** in the league.
- **AGF’s Jeppe Kjær** later became a **Superliga top scorer** in 2016–17 (17 goals).
- **Hobro IK’s stadium (DS Arena)** had a capacity of just **7,500**, making their promotion playoff win even more impressive.

---
### **Sources & Further Reading**
- [Danish Football Association (DBU) Archives](https://www.dbu.dk/)
- [Soccerway – 2014–15 1st Division](https://www.soccerway.com/)
- [Flashscore – Historical Standings](https://www.flashscore.com/)
- [Wikipedia – 2014–15 Danish 1st Division](https://en.wikipedia.org/)
